non_destructive_self_match_demo.interpretation: pgrep -f matches the remote bash argv containing the needle. pkill -f with the same needle would terminate that shell. CX2G never runs pkill -f chromium.

remediation: stop_owned_shell_runtime(): systemctl stop owned unit → wait cgroup empty → kill only owned PIDs
